cohort: The participants were nulliparous individuals with singleton pregnancies and cephalic presentation who delivered at term.
finding: Nonlabor cesarean delivery was associated with an increased risk of the composite neonatal outcome across all BMI categories, although this increase was less pronounced in higher BMI categories.
mod_finding: Nonlabor cesarean delivery was associated with adverse neonatal outcomes across all BMI categories, though the relative increase in risk was diminished in higher BMI groups; for maternal outcomes, nonlabor cesarean was associated with increased risk in lower BMI groups but lower risk in higher BMI groups compared to attempted vaginal delivery.
